def snap(frame):
    seg = frame.segmentation
    out = []
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels'] >= 8 and n['color'] in ('W','G','O','p','P','M'):
            rows=[q[0] for q in n['boundary']]; cols=[q[1] for q in n['boundary']]
            out.append((n['color'], n['pixels'], (min(rows)+max(rows))/2, (min(cols)+max(cols))/2))
    return sorted(out)
print('before:', snap(current_frame))
r = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':30,'col':20}])
print('after :', snap(current_frame))
fl = [t for t in snap(current_frame) if t[0]=='W' and t[1]<20][0]
kn = [t for t in snap(current_frame) if t[0]=='O'][0]
X = (9.0,49.0)
print('flower', fl[2:], 'knot', kn[2:], 'X', X)
print('midpoint flower-X:', ((fl[2]+X[0])/2,(fl[3]+X[1])/2))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
